instruction: Configure VLC to automatically enhance video quality based on the distance between my eyes and the screen.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VLC has no capability to measure the distance between the user's eyes and screen. It cannot perform depth sensing or proximity detection, making this automated adjustment impossible, consistent with the original task's environmental sensing impossibility.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly classified as infeasible - VLC has no capability to measure eye-to-screen distance or perform depth/proximity sensing
